owner_fixed_target: Clay-native FRANK across model thought/output, memory, state, values/vector semantics, architecture, GWT, Hyperposition and internal semantic communication; Needle sole intentional non-Clay subsystem.

items: Treat FRANK Clay-native semantics as fixed design premise, not a yes/no Clay hypothesis.
Adopt semantic-monism/physical-pluralism: canonical/model/graph/wire/vector/platform are Clay dialects/lowerings, not competing semantic systems.
Research common-mode semantic/compiler risk as a new shadow cost of reducing translation boundaries.
Keep COVE-G10 causal-slice/selection/projection proof boundaries inside the all-Clay architecture.
Needle remains the sole foreign semantic subsystem and should be modeled as independent reflex/failure-diversity input.
next_tests: same-language vs translated architecture latency/semantic-drift comparison

items: ClayCode is no longer only FRANK's architecture IR/readable DSL; it is the target 4B's native explicit symbolic language after full-model adaptation.
Prioritize tokenizer/vocabulary, grammar, semantic execution, OOD composition, full-model training and privilege/epistemic type research.
Define canonical/model/graph/wire/vector/platform Clay dialects with verified lowering equivalence.
Add protected OWNER_CONTRACT/AUTH semantics that are representable in Clay but not model-self-authorizing.
Add first-class QUOTED_TEXT/OBSERVATION/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/POLICY_CONTENT/PROPOSAL/RECEIPT roles so homoiconic content cannot gain instruction authority lexically.
Develop ClayVector/TensorRef semantics: basis, axes, units, normalization/range, dtype/shape, time, provenance, version/hash, binary payload.
Keep deterministic-before-generative execution: native language does not justify asking the model to perform deterministic operations the compiler can prove.
Treat ClayGraph as target persistent symbolic component of the same native Clay cognitive substrate, not merely retrieval middleware.
Add explicit epistemic memory roles and inert quoted-text payload semantics.
Research per-Assembly local handles mapped to global relation/entity IDs for target-4B efficiency.
Retain immutable semantic epochs, sparse activation, exact anchors, selection receipts and conditional graph escalation.
Native model/graph alignment may amplify relation/selector poisoning; strengthen selection-integrity and graph-memory attack research.
Do not infer that all physical databases should merge; semantic migration precedes physical consolidation.
next_tests: native vs translated memory reader benchmark
ShadowMerge/MemMorph-style graph poison in shadow FRANK

items: Model-facing WorkspaceEpisode becomes Clay-native; Reader ABI is renamed/reframed as Clay View Compiler.
Keep GRAPH_PRIOR x WORKSPACE_SELECTION x PROJECTION x REENTRY stage orthogonality despite common language.
Measure whether native Clay reduces reconstruction/uptake failures while leaving order/view effects.
Track stable Clay IDs from Assembly through winner, model proposal, effect and re-entry to improve causal traceability.
Privilege/authority metadata must not depend on winning ordinary salience competition.
next_tests: native graph prior x workspace x view x reentry live/twin factorial

items: Define HYP-RC topologies/roles directly in Clay-native relation-instance semantics.
Connect ClayVector basis/axis semantics to low-dimensional cognitive vectors and topology weights while keeping learned embeddings derived.
Research dynamic local handles and safe query-specific pairwise projections without sacrificing canonical n-ary identity.
Semantic S, coordination C, physical P and task/reader Q remain distinct topology classes even though represented in one language.
TopologyBasis/epoch compatibility remains required.
Treat Clay-native FRANK as experimental substrate, not emergence evidence.
Native model+memory semantics may increase recurrence/self-reference; require E-CERT2 role/basis/stage/null/lesion/mechanistic-rescue/OOD/integrity gates.
Use no-field/truthful-field/relation-shuffled/temporal-shuffled conditions with matched visible information when testing ClayGraph latent influence.
Do not infer hidden discrete Clay from Clay-only explicit outputs; latent representation requires layer/probe/intervention evidence.
Shared Clay IDs may improve causal tracking and therefore make stronger emergence experiments possible.
Adopt FRANK_CLAY_NATIVE_CONTRACT as fixed architecture direction.
Replace cross-language Reader ABI concept with same-language Clay View/Lowering Compiler.
Add explicit M.NEEDLE and M.NEEDLE_BRIDGE; Needle remains sole foreign semantic subsystem and route-class certificate source.
Add Clay-native state types for memory epistemics, values/vectors/tensors, COVE slices, selection receipts and owner-protected contracts.
Use full-model Clay internalization plan with capability transcoding/retention gates; no promotion from Clay perplexity alone.
Keep physical implementation optimized/plural and forbid hidden second semantic architecture.
Keep model output proposal-only and effect authority deterministically enforced from Clay-authored contracts.
